children: Arthur Hayes has added to his UNI holdings again, with his position exceeding $2 million since yesterday. According to PANews, monitoring by Ai Yi showed that over the past hour, his address 0x6cd…47e21 received 39,000 UNI from FalconX, increasing his UNI holdings to 284,101 tokens with a total value of $2.007 million and an average acquisition price of $7.06.
This was Hayes' first large UNI transaction in nine months, and UNI has become his third-largest on-chain holding asset.

title: Arthur Hayes Adds More UNI, Holdings Rise to 284,101 Tokens
